title: DECISION (#942): `ClusterIdentityWarning`: which boundaries count (H2: any in span vs adjacent), and whether a partial renumbering needs a size threshold (H3)
human_rulings:
**RULING (@ligon, 2026-10-19):**
- **H2:** keep **SPAN** as built. Every non-stable boundary between the first and last requested wave counts: zero misses, at the cost of 3 over-warnings.
